observations.observation: A solid, elongated shaft body extends predominantly along one axis.
Multiple cylindrical stepped regions extend along the same elongated body.
Longitudinal splines are visibly formed at both ends of the shaft body.
The form is a stepped shaft with splined ends, not a headed screw.
